div.div:
Measured on mk4 (Hetzner cax21: 4 arm64 cores, 8 GiB)
1024 dimensions, L2-normalised, no prefix
cold load 5 s; one warm query about 650 ms
about 0.7 chunks/s; a batch of 32 takes about 45 s
about 1.3 GiB resident; about 3.5 of 4 cores while embedding

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #334155; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Why Ollama and not Hugging Face TEI
TEI publishes CPU images for amd64 only, and mk4's nodes are arm64.
Ollama serves bge-m3's dense vectors only, not its sparse or multi-vector output: both callers keep keyword search in PostgreSQL.
OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL is 2, but the runner embeds with -np 1.

text.tspan: Why Ollama and not Hugging Face TEI
TEI publishes CPU images for amd64 only, and mk4's nodes are arm64.
Ollama serves bge-m3's dense vectors only, not its sparse or multi-vector output:
both callers keep keyword search in PostgreSQL.
OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL is 2, but the runner embeds with -np 1.
